detail.longDescription: I made my own CSS component library! 🧱 It's called klods (Danish for brick), and it's tiny pieces of HTML and CSS that click together. One stylesheet and it already looks good, and every colour, space and component can be overridden to make it your own. You can use it from plain HTML, JavaScript or Ruby, and it's already holding up at least five of my sites. https://www. druewilding.com/2026/11/21/bui lding-with-bricks.html # CSS # WebDev # HTML # JavaScript # Ruby
